newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom names ad agency for sale.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom names ad agency for sale.

text.p: Portugal Telecom on Tuesday said it selected J. Walter Thompson and Imago-Imagem e Comunicacao to provide advertising and publicity services for the forthcoming partial privatisation of the telecommunications operator.
"J. Walter Thompson was chosen after considering proposals from six agencies," the company said in a statement.
The government plans to sell a 26 percent stake of PT's capital of 190 billion escudos in a third-stage privatisation in the last quarter.
Imago, a Portuguese firm, took part in the two previous sales of PT stock. J. Walter Thompson is an international advertising agency owned by WPP Group Plc.
